t.E902.agn: In 2012 EFSA stated that it is not genotoxic. As long-term data were lacking, it did not set an ADI; however, as the margin of safety was considered sufficient, it concluded that there is no safety concern at the authorised uses. JECFA and the SCF had also found its use as a glazing agent acceptable without setting an ADI.
t.E902.body: Its absorption is expected to be low; absorbed components enter normal metabolism.
t.E902.found.0: Fruit surface (citrus fruits, melons, apples, pears, peaches, pineapples) and nuts
t.E902.found.2: Coffee beans, snacks and food supplements
t.E902.prod: A wax obtained by boiling the dried stems of the candelilla plant in water.
t.E902.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no ADI set, no safety concern at the authorised uses.
t.E902.summary: A plant wax obtained from the candelilla plant. A glazing agent in confectionery and chewing gum.
t.E902.what: A plant wax obtained from the leaves of the candelilla plant (Euphorbia antisyphilitica); used as a glazing agent.
